payload.name: Photo 160x200 Under 30KB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup 160 x 200 photo workflow for 30KB upload limits.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based 160 x 200 photo under 30KB workflow for forms that require exact compact portrait pixels plus a strict KB cap. It points to local resize and image-to-KB compression steps, requires no account and no server file upload, and includes an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
